notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
A few updates today:

- Fixed a rare bug with an item tooltip not disappearing on some devices

- Dialogue system now doesn't provide to Adolf your Windows username, but takes your username from Steam

notes.title: Hotfix update
notes.notes:
Two updates per day! Again.

[list]
[*] Fixed a critical bug monster in mansion after bossfight
[/list]

notes.title: Difficulty update
notes.notes:
Happy International Women's Day! I've made some changes about game's difficulty.

Game now has 3 difficulties: easy (monster is almost deaf and much slower), normal (almos like OG difficulty, but bossfight is a bit easier and Dog is doing more gamage) and hardcore mode (really chalenging one).

Try this out and have a nice day! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Two patches for price of one![/h2]

Did some more minor fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fix: bunch of localization and voice bugs in dialogue with NPC for each language
[*] Fix: wrong localization for some crucial game notes
[*] Add: new hint for shield item, more hint info in pentagram note
[/list]

If you will encounter some more issues with game localization on your language (or any issues at all), feel free to contact tech support ːsteamhappyː
